I reproduced the same toast in Glass three times. One terminal only printed http://localhost :61100/ . A
different terminal started the server and printed only ready . Glass still opened the Browser tab and showed
the auto-open toast.
The terminal watcher combines the URL from one command with machine-wide before-and-after port
snapshots. It does not verify that the new listener belongs to that command or terminal. A server that starts in
another terminal during the URL-only command can therefore look command-owned. The current tests cover
an existing port and a new same-command port, but not this cross-terminal case.
For the agent fixing this: re-run the repro path above to verify your fix. Write a failing test, then fix the issue.
